First Kid On The Playground - Wayne

Wayne knew two things in his line of work. Pushing one button would keep him in his position, where he could keep pushing that same button at set intervals of time for eight hours a day and hope for a pay raise to motivate him to push the button more enthusiastically. He also knew that pushing the second button at the wrong time would get him in trouble, because that was the button that caused the robot arm to shake and flail. The actual reason for this was an in-depth flaw in the wiring which would cause unpredictable movements when the right button was supposed to cause the arm to retract. A few days after the right button stopped working, though, they just fixed the left button to extend the robot's right arm, place and tighten the lid on the next jar of pickles, and retract. Wayne's world for eight hours was pushing a button to watch a robot's arm go into an assembly line, turn a jar lid, and retract out. Repeat. He was always good at that sort of thing, though.

He was known to his partners as Hokey Pokey, and he could control the arm or leg movements of anyone by telling them to put in or take out that body part. The Jungle Gym Heroes, who regularly had the world laughing at them because of the name they gave themselves, used their unique powers to stop what they labelled as "The Briefcase Brigade." They did themselves no favors by giving their nemeses such a ridiculous name, though. They had one rule, though: nobody killed anyone. They weren't the type to cause game overs, and they would avoid harm as much as possible. Their troubles, though, were how incognito the Brigade was. The Brigade members would look like most other members of the corporate world, with suits, polo shirts, golf shorts, khaki pants, or clean-shave haircuts that looked like they knew their barber's family like their own. The Heroes couldn't help but jump when they heard the words "carpool" or "telecommute," and "conference calls" could only mean disaster.

And so Wayne worked each day, knowing that he and his team were the only defense for the world against being perpetually grounded. He continued to protect the world itself by being the best spy around and find all intelligence possible about their enemies. And he continued to protect the world of pickle-eaters by making a machine do the hokey pokey.
